neighbours.label: the token just before a bare letter 's' in technical notation, as a predictor of that 's': the digit before an orbital 's' (4s, 3s), the '7' of the Springer DOI prefix 10.1007/s, and the width digit of a '%17s' format; other DOI prefixes, prose and other formats are silent
fire: After the 3d level fills, the next electrons go into the 4s orbital.
quiet: Sodium has an atomic number of 11 and a mass of 23.
After the third step, the solution is heated and then cooled slowly.
Calcium has 20 protons, 20 electrons and 20 neutrons.

predictions: fire 0.4-0.8 on the token before 's' in orbitals, 10.1007/s DOIs and %Ns formats; other DOIs, plain numbers and string concatenation below 0.15
notes: Card: peaks on ' %', '7', '">%', '4' before 's'; + side suppresses 's' tokens. Probe: orbital '4' 0.812, DOI 10.1007/s '7' 0.709, '%17s' '7' 0.602, '%s' 0.204; DOI 10.1016/j 0.048, prose '7 %' 0.001, '%d ... %5.3f' leaked 0.285 at '5' (so near misses avoid numeric formats).
